summary: Backend 6/6 tests pass (100%): health, weather (Open-Meteo Rome shows temp/pressure/humidity/AQI), space-weather (NOAA Kp 3.3 Quiet + solar_wind 486km/s + IMF Bz + flare B9.5 + sunspots 94.4), ISS (wheretheiss.at live position), and AI /api/ai/chat SSE streaming with GPT-5.5 (delta events + [DONE] terminator) with user+assistant messages persisted and retrievable via /api/ai/history. Frontend 5/6 major flows pass: Home renders wordmark + all 8 module cards (module-now, module-sky, module-universe, module-invisible, module-space-weather, module-audio, module-timeline, module-ai); Meteo Spaziale renders real NOAA data (Kp 3.3 badge, solar wind 486 km/s, IMF Bz 0.0nT/Bt 4.0nT, flare B9.5, sunspots 94.4); Universo orrery renders 8 planets, segmented control scope-inner/scope-all toggles, tapping planet-jupiter opens ObjectSheet with 'Giove' info; Timeline datetime-card shows +1g step change and now-button resets; Assistente suggestion chip triggers SSE streaming and full assistant bubble appears (~875 chars); Qui e Ora and Cielo show correct permission gate UI without crashing. CRITICAL BUG: /realta-invisibile CRASHES on web with 'this._nativeModule.addListener is not a function' from expo-sensors Magnetometer — the sensor hook does not guard against Platform.OS==='web' so the gate UI never renders (violates 'gate UI renders without crashing' acceptance).

ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught runtime error 'this._nativeModule.addListener is not a function' from expo-sensors Magnetometer/Accelerometer/DeviceMotion when opened on web preview. The screen never renders a gate UI — it hard-crashes. Reference: /app/frontend/src/hooks/useSensors.ts:11 (Magnetometer.setUpdateInterval), :25, :44, :63 (DeviceMotion). Guard subscription with Platform.OS!=='web' or Magnetometer.isAvailableAsync() and render a 'sensori non disponibili sul web' fallback in /app/frontend/app/realta-invisibile.tsx.

react_native_issues.issue: expo-sensors (Magnetometer, Accelerometer, DeviceMotion) is not implemented on react-native-web and throws 'this._nativeModule.addListener is not a function'. Hooks must early-return on web (Platform.OS==='web') or call isAvailableAsync() before addListener. Reference: /app/frontend/src/hooks/useSensors.ts:7-73.

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/hooks/useSensors.ts: gate every subscription with Platform.OS!=='web' (or Sensor.isAvailableAsync()) and return neutral defaults on web so /realta-invisibile can render its permission/unavailable gate without crashing.
Optionally add a testID (e.g. 'invisible-screen' or 'sensors-unavailable-gate') on /app/frontend/app/realta-invisibile.tsx root View for future automated verification of the gate.

rca_of_issue: Realta Invisibile crash RCA: The screen imports useMagnetometer/useHeading/useAccelerometer from src/hooks/useSensors.ts which unconditionally call Magnetometer.setUpdateInterval() then Magnetometer.addListener() on mount. On react-native-web, expo-sensors' NativeModule is missing addListener, causing a JS runtime crash before the JSX gate can render. Reproduction: open /realta-invisibile in web preview → console shows 'this._nativeModule.addListener is not a function' and body shows the red error overlay instead of the module UI. Mitigation: In useSensors.ts wrap each useEffect body with `if (Platform.OS === 'web') return;` and return neutral zero readings, or use `Magnetometer.isAvailableAsync()` before addListener.
